result.instructions: Tools for Ziflow, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our proofs are late or have changes required?"; "List the open, unresolved comments on the spring brochure proof."; "Show the activity log for the packaging proof from last week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ziflow data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ziflow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ziflow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ziflow_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ziflow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ziflow_create_proof
tools.title: Create proof from file or video URLs
tools.description: WRITE: import files/videos into new Ziflow proofs from URLs Ziflow can download (including signed URLs or S3 with a configured credentials nickname). Local file bytes are not accepted by this API: upload them to approved storage first. Set approver/commenter permissions per stage and include owner_email as a reviewer in at least one stage. Multiple sources create a batch unless combine=true (combining depends on the Ziflow plan). Processing is asynchronous; use ziflow_get_proof to check completion. May email reviewers after processing; suppress_all_emails=true disables proof emails. Not idempotent: never automatically repeat creation after an uncertain result. POST /proofs.

owner_email.description: Existing Ziflow user's email; must also appear among the stage reviewers.

nickname.description: For an s3:// source: the AWS credentials nickname already configured in Ziflow API Account Settings. Never supply AWS keys here.

sources.description: Downloadable file/video URLs. Every source is submitted as Ziflow type=file.

role.description: Approvers can comment and decide; commenters can comment but cannot decide. Neither role grants management or sharing permissions.

stages.description: Review stages; stage count is limited by the connected account's Ziflow plan.

folder_id.description: Destination folder ID; some accounts require it.

combine.description: Combine sources into one multi-asset proof instead of a batch (default false). Mixed media requires Enterprise.

confirm.description: true only after the user approved the files, reviewer permissions and notification choice.

annotations.title: Create proof from file or video URLs

tools.name: ziflow_add_reviewers
tools.title: Add approvers or commenters to a stage
tools.description: WRITE: add reviewers to an existing proof stage, with explicit approver (comment + decision) or commenter (comment only) permissions. Neither grants management or sharing rights. May notify reviewers. Does not move reviewers out of other stages. Get proof/stage IDs with ziflow_get_proof. Not idempotent; do not automatically retry. POST /proofs/{proof_id}/stages/{stage_id}/reviewers.

proof_id.description: The proof id (from ziflow_list_proofs or ziflow_search_proofs).

role.description: Approvers can comment and decide; commenters can comment but cannot decide. Neither role grants management or sharing permissions.

confirm.description: true only after the user approved adding these reviewers with these permissions.

annotations.title: Add approvers or commenters to a stage

tools.name: ziflow_list_proofs
tools.title: List proofs
tools.description: List proofs (review items) visible to the API user, with name, status, owner and deadlines. Good first call to discover proof ids. Ziflow API: GET /proofs.

tools.name: ziflow_get_proof
tools.title: Get a proof
tools.description: Get one proof by id: its name, status, stages, reviewers, deadlines, folder and version data. Ziflow API: GET /proofs/{id}.

proof_id.description: The proof id (from ziflow_list_proofs or ziflow_search_proofs).

tools.name: ziflow_search_proofs
tools.title: Search proofs
tools.description: Search proofs by name and status. Use proof_status to find, for example, proofs with changes_required or late. Ziflow API: POST /proofs/search.

tools.name: ziflow_list_proof_activities
tools.title: List proof activity
tools.description: List the activity log of one proof (who did what, and when), optionally between two dates. Ziflow API: GET /proofs/{id}/activities.

proof_id.description: The proof id (from ziflow_list_proofs or ziflow_search_proofs).

start_date.description: Start of the range, as the API expects it (ISO 8601).

end_date.description: End of the range, as the API expects it (ISO 8601).

tools.name: ziflow_list_comments
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: List all comments on one proof, with their author, location (page or time), and resolved state. Ziflow API: GET /proofs/{id}/comments.

proof_id.description: The proof id (from ziflow_list_proofs or ziflow_search_proofs).

tools.name: ziflow_get_comment
tools.title: Get a comment
tools.description: Get one comment on a proof by its id, including its replies, labels and resolved state. Ziflow API: GET /proofs/{id}/comments/{comment_id}.

proof_id.description: The proof id (from ziflow_list_proofs or ziflow_search_proofs).

tools.name: ziflow_list_folders
tools.title: List root folders
tools.description: List the root folders the API user can see. Ziflow API: GET /folders.

tools.name: ziflow_get_folder
tools.title: Get a folder
tools.description: Get one folder by id, with its name and contents. Ziflow API: GET /folders/{id}.

tools.name: ziflow_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the Ziflow account, with their roles and status. Ziflow API: GET /users.

tools.name: ziflow_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id or email address. Ziflow API: GET /users/{identifier}.

identifier.description: The user id or email address.

tools.name: ziflow_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts (external reviewers saved in the account), with name and email. Ziflow API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: ziflow_list_workflow_templates
tools.title: List workflow templates
tools.description: List the workflow templates (review stages and reviewer sets) that new proofs can start from. Ziflow API: GET /workflowtemplates.

tools.name: ziflow_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhook subscriptions
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions set up on the account, with their event types and target URLs. Ziflow API: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: ziflow_add_comment
tools.title: Add a comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a proof at a page (or a time range for audio/video). The comment is visible to every reviewer on the proof. Not idempotent: each call adds a new comment. Ziflow API: POST /proofs/{id}/comments.

proof_id.description: The proof id (from ziflow_list_proofs or ziflow_search_proofs).

page.description: Page number for static or rich-media proofs.

start_time.description: Start time HH:mm:ss.SSS for audio or video proofs.

end_time.description: End time HH:mm:ss.SSS for audio or video proofs.

asset_id.description: Asset id, when the proof has more than one asset.

parent_comment_id.description: Reply to this comment id instead of starting a new thread.

tools.name: ziflow_resolve_comment
tools.title: Resolve or reopen a comment
tools.description: Mark a comment as resolved, or reopen it. Setting the same state twice is harmless. Ziflow API: PUT /proofs/{id}/comments/{comment_id}/resolve.

proof_id.description: The proof id (from ziflow_list_proofs or ziflow_search_proofs).
